title: livemsg-gate.v1
description: Verdict for one outbound cross-session message. Produced only when [livemsg] verification is on; while it is off the gate is never called and no artifact exists.

verdict.description: SEND delivers the message. HOLD delivers nothing and returns reason to the sender.

reason.description: Why the verdict was reached. Required on HOLD so the sender can correct and retry; on SEND it may be a short confirmation.

checked.description: Every check that ran, in order. An empty array means no check ran and the verdict is not evidence-backed.

check.description: file_exists / commit_exists / git_status_matches are deterministic machine checks. agent_review is the read-only judge, used only for claims a machine cannot decide.

result.description: not_observed means the check could not run. It is not the same as fail, and must never be reported as absence of a problem.

subject.description: What the check was about: a repo-relative path, a commit-ish, or a short claim excerpt.

detail.description: Short machine-readable evidence for the result.
